channel.title: HomerDev Walkthroughs
channel.description: Spoken walks through the Homer Development Kit: what it is, how it builds and releases an app, and what its shared code makes a person hear. Twelve walks, each three to five minutes.
channel.itunes:author: Jamal Mazrui

item.title: 00 - Overview and Table of Contents
item.description: Nothing is needed; this walk is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0-00-overview-and-table-of-contents

item.title: 01 - Install and Launch
item.description: Windows 10 or later, 64-bit, a screen reader running, and HomerDev dot zip downloaded. Everything else the kit fetches for itself. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0a-01-install-and-launch

item.title: 02 - User Interface Concepts
item.description: Nothing is needed; this walk is listened to. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0b-02-user-interface-concepts

item.title: 03 - Key Patterns
item.description: Nothing is needed; a Homer program open to try the keys is a bonus. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0c-03-key-patterns

item.title: 04 - Start an App from the Kit
item.description: The kit is at C colon backslash HomerDev, and a command prompt is open there. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0d-04-start-an-app-from-the-kit

item.title: 05 - Build, Check and Release
item.description: An app built on the kit is open in a command prompt, with a change made and GitHub signed in. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0e-05-build-check-and-release

item.title: 06 - The Installer and Its Finish Page
item.description: A Homer program's installer is downloaded, and your reader is running. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0f-06-the-installer-and-its-finish-page

item.title: 07 - Spoken Tutorials
item.description: An app built on the kit, with its help folder open. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0g-07-spoken-tutorials

item.title: 08 - Shared Code and the Homer Player
item.description: FileDir and DbDo are installed, with mpv. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0h-08-shared-code-and-the-homer-player

item.title: 09 - Glossary
item.description: Nothing is needed. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0i-09-glossary

item.title: 10 - Conclusion
item.description: Nothing is needed. Full transcript: Tutorials.htm#0j-10-conclusion
